# Kestrel

> Kestrel is a fictional AI resolution agent for banks, insurers and clinics, used as placeholder content for a design-faithful site rebuild. It closes customer cases end to end, hands off to people when it should, and keeps a reviewable record of every step.

This file follows the llms.txt format: a short summary, then links to the pages most useful to a language model. All content is placeholder copy.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Kestrel does, how it compares, the tools and integrations it uses, and customer stories
- [Press kit](/press-kit): brand guidelines with logo files, colour palette and typefaces
- [Kestrel Jobs](/cx-jobs): a board of customer-support roles at teams that work with AI

## Assets

- [Lockup (SVG)](/assets/presskit/kestrel-lockup.svg): primary mark and wordmark
- [Mark (SVG)](/assets/presskit/kestrel-mark.svg): standalone mark

## Optional
